data.title: 菲伦 · 旅店壁炉边的赌气
data.description: 【成年菲伦 · 壁炉边的黑丝足尖】风雪交加的夜里，成年菲伦独坐在旅店壁炉前的厚地毯上。松开的睡袍盖住腰际，她把一条黑色长袜缓慢卷到脚踝，另一条腿仍被薄纱紧紧包裹；裸足伸向火光，脚趾因冷热交替蜷起，褪袜的双手在大腿留下清晰勒痕。紫色长发垂过丰满胸线，她气鼓鼓地别脸——「既然一直盯着，就把哪一边更暖看清楚……真是不知羞耻。」
data.promptProse: Snow beats the inn window while adult Fern sits on a rug before the hearth, her robe open over bare breasts. Both hands roll one black stocking down her thigh to the ankle as the other leg remains sheathed. The bare sole reaches toward the fire, toes curling from the heat and creating foreground depth; pressure marks lead back to her rounded body. Purple hair catches copper light while she pouts sideways with wet eyes and red ears. Horizontal intimate portrait, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Curled up by the warm hearth wrapped in a slipping blanket, Fern sulks with flushed cheeks as firelight sculpts her curvy chest.
